title: Cap Code Graph v1
description: Typed node/edge payload binding rhizome exports to cap's architecture graph view. Extends the code-graph-v1 vocabulary with visual and confidence fields required for interactive graph rendering. Producer: rhizome export. Consumer: cap visualization layer.

nodes.description: Graph nodes representing code symbols. Each node carries identity, classification, source location, and visual/confidence metadata for cap rendering.

edges.description: Graph edges representing typed relationships between code symbols, with weight and confidence for cap visualization.

GraphNode.description: A single code symbol node in the cap architecture graph.

id.description: Stable unique identifier for the node within this graph payload. code-graph-v1 keys nodes by 'name', which is not guaranteed globally unique for cap's rendering keys, so a rhizome producer synthesizes 'id' (e.g. a path-qualified symbol like 'auth::verify_token').

name.description: Human-readable symbol name. Displayed as the node label in cap.

labels.description: Classification labels consistent with code-graph-v1 (e.g., 'type:function', 'domain:auth'). Used by cap to drive filter and grouping controls.

description.description: Human-readable description of the symbol. Shown in cap node detail panels.

metadata.description: Source location and language metadata. Mirrors the metadata shape in code-graph-v1.

confidence_level.description: Analysis confidence for this node (0.0 = uncertain, 1.0 = fully verified). Used by cap to vary node opacity or border style.

flag.description: When true, cap highlights this node as requiring attention (e.g., flagged for review, anomaly detected).

shape.description: Requested rendering shape for this node in cap's graph layout (e.g., 'circle', 'diamond', 'rect'). Cap may fall back to a default shape when the value is unrecognized.

color.description: Optional CSS color string (hex, rgb, or named color) for node fill in cap. When absent, cap applies its theme default.

border_color.description: Optional CSS color string for node border/stroke in cap.

GraphEdge.description: A typed relationship between two GraphNode ids in the cap architecture graph.

source.description: Id of the source node. Must reference a node id present in the nodes array.

target.description: Id of the target node. Must reference a node id present in the nodes array.

relation.description: Typed relationship between symbols. The relation vocabulary is identical to code-graph-v1 so the edge type needs no translation; note that node identity is promoted to an explicit 'id' (see GraphNode.id), so node mapping is not a pure passthrough.

weight.description: Edge importance (0.0 = negligible, 1.0 = critical). Used by cap to vary edge thickness or visibility. Default weights align with code-graph-v1: contains=1.0, imports=0.5, implements=0.8, calls=0.3.

confidence_level.description: Analysis confidence for this edge (0.0 = uncertain, 1.0 = fully verified). Used by cap to vary edge opacity or dash style.

label.description: Optional text label rendered on the edge in cap. When absent, cap may render the relation value.
